__comment: The raw materials crate (doc 294). A plank piece since doc 308 (the owner's pick of 2026-11-13, the open bin, after asking for nothing through its middle): a sawn post at each corner, two boards a side with a gap between them, pegged through the posts, open on top and with no floor, within its 2 x 2 footprint, its sides 12 cells high and its posts 13. Its Tier 1 form was the log crib of notched logs (doc 294, concept A; doc 301), whose design is kept in tools/hearthblock/art/tier1.mjs. Tier 2 Hearthblock model from tools/hearthblock/art/tier2.mjs.
Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench from four matching planks; it keeps their wood. It stands on the floor, and dwarves reach into it from any side.

storage (ContainerStorageComponent): it holds rough stone, the ores and coal, and soil (stockpile_stone, stockpile_ore, stockpile_soil), three goods to each of its four quarters (per_slot), starting at priority 4, ahead of ground storage. The anchors are its quarters' places on the ground inside it (X and Z 6 cells from its centre), in footprint-local blocks from the back-left floor corner; each filled quarter shows one of its goods inside the crib.
description: A plank bin, open on top: a sawn post at each corner and two boards a side, pegged. It keeps twelve raw goods, rough stone, ore, coal or soil, three to each quarter.
